# dsh-flomo
> **English** | **中文**
Send notes, memos, and summaries straight into flomo (浮墨笔记) from DeepSeek Harness. Configure your fl
omo API URL or API Key once, then any agent can record ideas via the `flomo_send` tool.
## Features
- **Settings panel** — configure the API URL / API Key from the web GUI: Settings → Flomo. Save, tes

t, clear, and a quick-send box.
- **flomo_send** — write a memo with optional tags (`tags` become `#
tags`), supporting `**bold**` and `![](image-url)` inline syntax. Tags go through the `tags` argumen
t; any ASCII `#` left in the body is escaped to the full-width `＃` before sending, so flomo never pa

rses body text as a tag (pass `escapeBodyHashes: false` to keep an inline `#tag`).
- **flomo_config*
* — set `apiKey` (newer key format) or `webhookUrl` (the API URL from the flomo settings page, typic

ally `https://flomoapp.com/iwh/<token>/`); `reset: true` clears the credential.
- **flomo_status** —
report whether the plugin is configured and where the credential lives, without echoing the full ke

y.
- Credential persisted to `$DSH_HOME/dsh-flomo.json` (default `~/.dsh/dsh-flomo.json`) with mode

`0600`.
- System-prompt announcement so agents know when to use the plugin.
## Install
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Restart `dsh web`. The plugin needs no build step — `lib/index.js` is plain ESM.
## Configuration
Get your API URL at <https://flomoapp.com/mine?source=incoming_webhook>. Then either paste it into t
he plugin's `cordis.patch.yml` config, or let the agent configure it for you:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The agent calls `flomo_config` with your `webhookUrl` (or `apiKey`) and persists it to `$DSH_HOME/ds
h-flomo.json` (default `~/.dsh/dsh-flomo.json`, mode `0600`). From then on:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
> The flomo API URL is a credential: anyone with it can write memos to your flomo. Keep it private;
use `flomo_config(reset: true)` to clear it if it leaks.
## Compatibility
- **DSH**: declared under `engines.dsh` as `^0.1.0-rc.6 || ^0.1.7-alpha.1 || ^0.2.0-alpha.1 || ^0.2.

1-alpha.1 || ^0.2.2-alpha.1`.
- **Node.js**: `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`.
- **Exactly verified DSH releas
es** (`dsh.compatibility.dshReleases`): `0.1.7-rc.1`, `0.2.1-rc.5`, `0.2.2-alpha.3`, `0.2.2-rc.1` →

`compatible`. Releases not listed stay `unknown` and are not claimed.
- How each entry is verified:
`npm run verify` packs the plugin, installs the tarball into a throwaway profile under an isolated `
DSH_HOME`, boots the host, calls `GET /api/dsh-flomo/config`, checks the client bundle is in the she
ll boot list, then uninstalls.
## Notes

- Sending uses Node's built-in `fetch` (Node 22+), no extra dependencies.
- The web settings panel t

alks to the host through the loopback-only `/api/dsh-flomo` route family.
- Respects flomo's content
syntax: `**bold**`, `![](https://.../image.png)`; tags are appended from `tags`, and body ASCII `#`
is escaped to `＃` so it can never spawn a stray tag.
